# Facts about Nikolai Todorov

- Name: Nikolai Todorov (GitHub: Narcoswiu). Based in Sofia and Kazanlak, Bulgaria.
- Role: Full-stack developer and AI Engineer. Co-founder of Wavsy (https://wavsy.dev), a web studio that builds fast, modern websites and custom AI systems for local businesses.
- Backend: C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, SignalR, Entity Framework Core, REST APIs, JWT auth.
- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Three.js, HTML, CSS.
- Data: MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle PL/SQL, Supabase.
- Tools: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Visual Studio, VS Code.
- AI work: builds AI assistants (answer customers 24/7 in Bulgarian, English and German on websites, WhatsApp and Viber), AI agents (book appointments, draft quotes, check availability, with a person approving what matters) and automations (enquiry to CRM, reports, alerts). Integrations: website, WhatsApp, Viber, Messenger, email, calendars, spreadsheets, CRM, invoices, booking systems. Work starts with a 2–4 week pilot; important actions always go through a person. A chat assistant is live on the KIBO - 2 website.
- Projects:

Next.js, React, Supabase, TypeScript, Tailwind. Officials get a phone app that records times even without coverage; standings follow the federation's rules; official sheets export as PDF.
  - TodorovNET.API (https://github.com/Narcoswiu/TodorovNet1): the original race-timing backend in ASP.NET Core with SignalR live leaderboard, EF Core, JWT and MS SQL.
  - Wavsy client sites: Storm Car Wash (Kazanlak), KIBO - 2 (plumbing & heating, Kazanlak), Glenz Reinigung (cleaning, Germany), Manufacturas Quezher (metalworking, Mexico), and the Cacao Cartel concept site (3D and scroll effects).
- Education: SoftUni — 8 courses, every one with a perfect 6.00 / 6.00 (Programming Basics, Programming Fundamentals with C#, C# Advanced, C# OOP, HTML & CSS, JS Front-End, MS SQL, Entity Framework Core), 2023–2025. IT-Kariera Software Engineering — all 8 modules completed (Introduction to Programming, Programming, Intro to OOP, Algorithms & Data Structures, OOP, Databases, Software Development, Operating & Embedded Systems).
